column2: Fresh -cfgfile profile; copied only Default_7.0.ReaperThemeZip; no custom keymap, mouse map, or third-party extensions
Actual mouse click establishes A1 or A2; Main actions 40529/40530 run with the pointer over A2; actual Shift-click on B2 follows; selected item IDs are read before and after each step

Baseline A1 then Shift-click B2 selects A1,B1,B2. After 40529 or 40530 adds A2, the same Shift-click selects A1,A2,B1,B2; after 40530 removes A2, it selects A1,B1,B2. Toggling off the sole anchor A2 leaves no selected items, but Shift-click B2 selects A2,B2. These follow-up gestures show the actions preserve the existing range anchor, including a deselected anchor.
REAPER ReaScript exposes selected items but not the private range-anchor field; the anchor is inferred from native Shift-click outcomes.
Two tracks; MIDI items A1/A2 and B1/B2 at 1-2, 4-5, 1-2, and 3-4 seconds
